items.title: Peter Ecklund interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998
items.q: a band I used to play with called Vince Giordano’s Nighthawks

ctx.x: Do you get involved and get calls to do that kind of thing?

Yeah. I’m not really in any one of them, but I’m kind a sub for a lot of them. I kind of prefer that actually because you get a lot of different experiences. There’s one I’ve played with run by a guy names Tony Corbiscello that’s really very good, that does like ‘50s and ‘60s stuff, which is music that I really know less well than others, so it’s really a lot of fun to do that. But another band that does 1920s music, which is a bit like a band I used to play with called Vince Giordano’s Nighthawks, so those are…
Vince is the bass saxophonist, is that right?
